data.title: 2nd Payment Reminder (2. Mahnung) from NetzMuster GmbH – EUR 49.99 due
data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH (internet/phone/TV provider) sent a second dunning notice (2. Mahnung) dated 26.03.2026 because the February 2026 invoice for customer number NM-3380271 is still unpaid. With a EUR 5.00 dunning fee added to the EUR 44.99 outstanding balance, EUR 49.99 total is requested by 07.04.2026, with a warning that the connection may be blocked for further delay.
data.explanation: This is a second dunning letter (2. Mahnung) from your internet/phone/TV provider, following an earlier payment reminder from 12.03.2026 that you apparently missed. They are asking you to pay the overdue February 2026 invoice plus a EUR 5.00 late fee, totalling EUR 49.99, by the date shown in the letter. If you don't pay in time, the provider warns it may suspend (block) your connection, and further reminder or collection fees could follow. If you already paid around this time, you can disregard the letter, as it states. If you believe the invoice is wrong, contact NetzMuster GmbH directly using the contact details on the letter.
